global.description: Globals meant for internal use only

fullnameOverride.description: fullnameOverride is the full name for the deployment. Leave empty to let Helm generate a name using chart values.

nameOverride.description: nameOverride is the short name for the deployment. Leave empty to let Helm generate a name using chart values.

secureMode.description: secureMode contains the options for enabling and configuring RBAC and TLS/HTTPs for the metrics endpoint.

affinity.description: affinity defines the node affinity rules for the operator pod.

automountServiceAccountToken.description: Automount API credentials for the Service Account into the pod.

caDir.description:
caDir defines the directory containing a CA certificate (tls.crt) and its associated private key (tls.key) to be used for all managed resources.
Setting this makes caRotateBefore and caValidity values ineffective.

caRotateBefore.description: caRotateBefore defines when to rotate a CA certificate that is due to expire.

caValidity.description: caValidity defines the validity period of the CA certificates generated by the operator.

certificatesRotateBefore.description: certificatesRotateBefore defines when to rotate a certificate that is due to expire.

certificatesValidity.description: certificatesValidity defines the validity period of certificates generated by the operator.

containerRegistry.description: containerRegistry to use for pulling Elasticsearch and other application container images.

disableConfigWatch.description: disableConfigWatch specifies whether the operator watches the configuration file for changes.

elasticsearchClientTimeout.description: elasticsearchClientTimeout sets the request timeout for Elasticsearch API calls made by the operator.

elasticsearchObservationInterval.description: Interval between observations of Elasticsearch health, non-positive values disable asynchronous observation.

enableLeaderElection.description: enableLeaderElection specifies whether leader election should be enabled

exposedNodeLabels.description: exposedNodeLabels is an array of regular expressions of node labels which are allowed to be copied as annotations on Elasticsearch Pods.

ipFamily.description: ipFamily specifies the IP family to use. Possible values: IPv4, IPv6 and "" (auto-detect)

kubeClientTimeout.description: kubeClientTimeout sets the request timeout for Kubernetes API calls made by the operator.

logVerbosity.description:
logVerbosity defines the logging level. Valid values are as follows:
-2: Errors only
-1: Errors and warnings
0: Errors, warnings, and information
number greater than 0: Errors, warnings, information, and debug details.

maxConcurrentReconciles.description: maxConcurrentReconciles is the number of concurrent reconciliation operations to perform per controller.

port.description: port defines the port to expose operator metrics. Set to 0 to disable metrics reporting.

secureMode.description: secureMode contains the options for enabling and configuring RBAC and TLS/HTTPs for the metrics endpoint.

enabled.description:
secureMode.enabled specifies whether to enable RBAC and TLS/HTTPs for the metrics endpoint.
* This option makes most sense when using a ServiceMonitor to scrape the metrics and is therefore mutually exclusive with the podMonitor.enabled option.
* This option also requires using cluster scoped resources (ClusterRole, ClusterRoleBinding) to
grant access to the /metrics endpoint. (createClusterScopedResources: true is required)

metricsPort.description: (Deprecated: use metrics.port: will be removed in v2.14.0) metricsPort defines the port to expose operator metrics. Set to 0 to disable metrics reporting.

policies.description:
policies contains policies for the operator, currently only password generation policies are supported.
passwords:
length: 24

restrictWatchedResources.description:
restrictWatchedResources restricts resource watching (secrets, services and configmaps) to resources carrying the
eck.k8s.elastic.co/watched=true label. When false (default), the operator watches all resources cluster-wide.

setDefaultSecurityContext.description:
setDefaultSecurityContext determines whether a default security context is set on application containers created by the operator.
*note* that the default option now is "auto-detect" to attempt to set this properly automatically when both running
in an openshift cluster, and a standard kubernetes cluster.  Valid values are as follows:
"auto-detect" : auto detect
"true"        : set pod security context when creating resources.
"false"       : do not set pod security context when creating resources.

ubiOnly.description:
ubiOnly specifies whether the operator will use only UBI container images to deploy Elastic Stack applications as well as for its own StatefulSet image. UBI images are only available from 7.10.0 onward.
Cannot be combined with the containerSuffix value.

validateStorageClass.description:
validateStorageClass specifies whether storage classes volume expansion support should be verified.
Can be disabled if cluster-wide storage class RBAC access is not available.

createClusterScopedResources.description: createClusterScopedResources determines whether cluster-scoped resources (ClusterRoles, ClusterRoleBindings) should be created.

dnsConfig.description:
dnsConfig defines the DNS configuration for the operator pod.
Check https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/services-networking/dns-pod-service/#pod-dns-config for more details.
dnsConfig:
nameservers:
- 169.254.20.10
searches:
- svc.cluster.local
options:
- name: ndots
value: "2"

dnsPolicy.description:
dnsPolicy defines the DNS policy for the operator pod.
Check https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/services-networking/dns-pod-service/#pod-s-dns-policy for more details.

global.description: Globals meant for internal use only

env.description: additional environment variables for the operator container.

extraObjects.description:
extraObjects allows injecting additional Kubernetes resources into the chart.
These resources will be created/deleted alongside the chart release.
The value can be a list or a map of strings, each string is a YAML manifest.
Helm templating is supported within each manifest.
Example (list):
extraObjects:
- |
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
name: {{ include "eck-operator.fullname" . }}-extra-config
namespace: {{ .Release.Namespace }}
data:
key: value
Example (map):
extraObjects:
myConfigMap: |
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
name: {{ include "eck-operator.fullname" . }}-extra-config
namespace: {{ .Release.Namespace }}
data:
key: value

fullnameOverride.description: fullnameOverride is the full name for the deployment. Leave empty to let Helm generate a name using chart values.

global.description: Globals meant for internal use only

manifestGen.description:
manifestGen specifies whether the chart is running under manifest generator.
This is used for tasks specific to generating the all-in-one.yaml file.

hostNetwork.description:
hostNetwork allows a Pod to use the Node network namespace.
This is required to allow for communication with the kube API when using some alternate CNIs in conjunction with webhook enabled.
If hostNetwork is enabled, dnsPolicy defaults to ClusterFirstWithHostNet unless explicitly set.
CAUTION: Proceed at your own risk. This setting has security concerns such as allowing malicious users to access workloads running on the host.

digest.description:
digest pins the image to a specific content digest for immutable image references.
When set, the rendered image reference becomes repo:tag@sha256:<hex>.
Must be in the format sha256:<hex> (64 hex characters).
Example:
digest: sha256:8c933444cb78d632d2d15851daf7bcb1fc4ec57689bb4aebf7b3353e6bf395a9

fips.description:
fips specifies whether the operator will use a FIPS compliant container image for its own StatefulSet image.
This setting does not apply to Elastic Stack applications images.
Can be combined with config.ubiOnly.

pullPolicy.description: pullPolicy is the container image pull policy.

repository.description: repository is the container image prefixed by the registry name.

tag.description: tag is the container image tag. If not defined, defaults to chart appVersion.

imagePullSecrets.description: imagePullSecrets defines the secrets to use when pulling the operator container image.

installCRDs.description:
installCRDs determines whether Custom Resource Definitions (CRD) are installed by the chart.
Note that CRDs are global resources and require cluster admin privileges to install.
If you are sharing a cluster with other users who may want to install ECK on their own namespaces, setting this to true can have unintended consequences.
1. Upgrades will overwrite the global CRDs and could disrupt the other users of ECK who may be running a different version.
2. Uninstalling the chart will delete the CRDs and potentially cause Elastic resources deployed by other users to be removed as well.

kubeAPIServerIP.description: kubeAPIServerIP is required when softMultiTenancy is enabled.

kubeAPIServerPort.description:
kubeAPIServerPort is the port used by the Kubernetes API server.
Only used when softMultiTenancy is enabled. Defaults to 443.

managedNamespaceSelector.description:
managedNamespaceSelector is a Kubernetes label selector that dynamically controls which namespaces the operator manages.
The operator watches all namespaces cluster-wide and filters events by matching each namespace's labels against
this selector at runtime. When a namespace gains or loses the matching labels the operator automatically
starts or stops managing resources in that namespace without a restart.
Mutually exclusive with managedNamespaces. Requires createClusterScopedResources: true.
Examples:
managedNamespaceSelector:
matchLabels:
eck-managed: "true"
managedNamespaceSelector:
matchExpressions:
- key: environment
operator: In
values: [production, staging]

managedNamespaces.description:
managedNamespaces is the set of namespaces that the operator manages. Leave empty to manage all namespaces.
Mutually exclusive with managedNamespaceSelector.

nameOverride.description: nameOverride is the short name for the deployment. Leave empty to let Helm generate a name using chart values.

nodeSelector.description: nodeSelector defines the node selector for the operator pod.

podAnnotations.description: podAnnotations define the annotations that should be added to the operator pod.

podDisruptionBudget.description:
podDisruptionBudget configures the minimum or the maxium available pods for voluntary disruptions,
set to either an integer (e.g. 1) or a percentage value (e.g. 25%).

podLabels.description: podLabels define additional labels that should be added to the operator pod.

podSecurityContext.description: podSecurityContext defines the pod security context for the operator pod.

priorityClassName.description: priorityClassName defines the PriorityClass to be used by the operator pods.

enforceRBAC.description: enforceRBAC specifies whether RBAC should be enforced for cross-namespace associations between resources.

replicaCount.description: replicaCount is the number of operator pods to run.

resources.description: resources define the container resource limits for the operator.

securityContext.description: securityContext defines the security context of the operator container.

create.description: create specifies whether a service account should be created for the operator.

name.description: name of the service account to use. If not set and create is true, a name is generated using the fullname template.

serviceMonitor.description:
Prometheus ServiceMonitor configuration
Only used when config.enableSecureMetrics is true
Reference: https://github.com/prometheus-operator/prometheus-operator/blob/master/Documentation/api.md#servicemonitor

enabled.description:
enabled determines whether the operator is installed with soft multi-tenancy extensions.
This requires network policies to be enabled on the Kubernetes cluster.

statefulsetAnnotations.description: statefulsetAnnotations define the annotations that should be added to the operator StatefulSet.

statefulsetLabels.description: statefulsetLabels define additional labels that should be added to the operator StatefulSet.

disabled.description: disabled determines whether the operator periodically updates ECK telemetry data for Kibana to consume.

distributionChannel.description: distributionChannel denotes which distribution channel was used to install the operator.

tolerations.description: tolerations defines the node tolerations for the operator pod.

config.description: config is a map of APM Server configuration variables that should be set in the environment.

enabled.description: enabled specifies whether APM tracing is enabled for the operator.

volumeMounts.description: additional volume mounts for the operator container.

volumes.description: additional volumes to add to the operator pod.

caBundle.description: caBundle is the PEM-encoded CA trust bundle for the webhook certificate. Only required if manageCerts is false and certManagerCert is null.

certManagerCert.description: certManagerCert is the name of the cert-manager certificate to use with the webhook.

certsDir.description: certsDir is the directory to mount the certificates.

certsSecret.description: secret specifies the Kubernetes secret to be mounted into the path designated by the certsDir value to be used for webhook certificates.

enabled.description: enabled determines whether the webhook is installed.

manageCerts.description: manageCerts determines whether the operator manages the webhook certificates automatically.

namespaceSelector.description:
namespaceSelector corresponds to the namespaceSelector property of the webhook.
Setting this restricts the webhook to act only on objects submitted to namespaces that match the selector.

objectSelector.description:
objectSelector corresponds to the objectSelector property of the webhook.
Setting this restricts the webhook to act only on objects that match the selector.

port.description: port is the port that the validating webhook binds to.
